subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu plugin send message fails with 400 error - receive_id_type is required

question: Should maintainers revive or repair the open conflicting fork PR, or close it and authorize a fresh narrow Feishu receive-id-type fix?
rationale: The issue remains valid enough to keep open, but an open conflicting fork PR already uses closing syntax, so a maintainer should choose the PR ownership path before automation creates another candidate.

options.title: Revive the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork author or a maintainer to rebase, address the prior type-safety review, and add real Feishu proof on the existing candidate.

options.title: Close fork and replace
options.body: Close the conflicting fork copy and authorize a fresh narrow fix against current main.

options.title: Wait for live repro
options.body: Leave the issue open without new code work until someone can replay the Feishu 400 in a real tenant.

recommendation.title: Close fork and replace
recommendation.body: Close the conflicting fork copy and authorize a fresh narrow fix against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin community maintainer, making them the best available owner for the target-semantics decision.
